run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T00:38:02Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend RequestErrorRate alert is driven by failures in the checkout path that originate in the shipping service. Frontend error spans were 0/5m until 00:37:02 and rose to ~500-715 per 5m from 00:38:02 onward, and they are confined to checkout operations (POST /api/checkout, executing api route /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder); every other frontend operation shows 0 errors. The failing span chain visible in the sampled traces is frontend POST /api/checkout (HTTP 500) -> checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (gRPC status 13) -> checkout HTTP POST -> shipping /get-quote (HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error'), whose outbound child span 'POST ' fails with Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat))). The shipping Deployment was rolled out at 00:36:42-00:36:49 with an unchanged image (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping) but a changed QUOTE_ADDR: the previous ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84 used QUOTE_ADDR="http://quote:8080", the new ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 uses QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000". That malformed address explains the client-side InvalidUri failure and the immediate 500 from shipping, which propagates as checkout status 13 and frontend HTTP 500s. quote itself is running, ready and exposed on port 8080, so quote availability is not the cause; flagd flags are all 'off', so flag-driven faults are not the cause either. The actor that changed the shipping environment value could not be observed (change history is not integrated).

claims.text: At 00:51:47 the frontend produced 1086.86 STATUS_CODE_ERROR span increases over 10 minutes versus 19871.8 STATUS_CODE_UNSET, i.e. frontend is emitting error spans at the time of the alert.

Frontend error activity began inside the window: increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m]) was 0 at every sampled point from 00:13:02 through 00:37:02, then 71.11 at 00:38:02, 377.78 at 00:41:02 and 715.56 at 00:45:02 (sampled points of the returned series).

Frontend errors are limited to the checkout flow: over 10 minutes ending 00:51:47, span_name grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, POST and POST /api/checkout each show 271.72 error-span increases, while GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/cart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds show 0.

Downstream of frontend, checkout errors appear on span names oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and HTTP POST (270.67 per 10 min), shipping errors on /get-quote and 'POST ' (270.67 per 10 min), and frontend-proxy errors on ingress and 'router frontend egress' (280.08 and 270.67 per 10 min).

Sampled spans show shipping's server span /get-quote (service shipping, version 2.1.3) ending in error with otel.status_code=ERROR and otel.status_description="Internal Server Error" after only ~61-70 microseconds, and its child span 'POST ' failing with otel.status_description="Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))" — a client-side URI parse failure rather than a network timeout.

The same sampled traces show the propagation with visible parent references: frontend POST /api/checkout and executing api route (pages) /api/checkout return http.status_code 500, frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder carries rpc.grpc.status_code 13 with grpc.error_message "13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500", and checkout's HTTP POST is the parent of shipping's /get-quote 500.

The shipping Deployment's pod template differs from its predecessor only by configuration: ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84 (created 00:00:11, replicas 0) set env QUOTE_ADDR="http://quote:8080", while the new ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 (created 00:36:42, replicas 1) sets QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000"; both use image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping.

The live shipping Deployment (revision 2) currently carries container env QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000" together with SHIPPING_PORT=8080 and OTEL_SERVICE_NAME derived from metadata.labels['app.kubernetes.io/component']; shipping is the only Deployment whose env shows this value.

Kubernetes events in namespace otel-demo show the shipping rollout at 00:36:42-00:36:49: Deployment shipping 'Scaled up replica set shipping-5ffdc77bc8 from 0 to 1' and 'Scaled down replica set shipping-75d58f5d84 from 1 to 0', ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 'Created pod: shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn', pod Scheduled at 00:36:42 and Started container shipping at 00:36:49, and old pod shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q killed at 00:36:49.

The replacement pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn is Running, its shipping container is ready with restartCount 0, created 00:36:42 and owned by ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8; its logs show 'Shipping service is running' and 'starting service: "actix-web-service-0.0.0.0:8080"' at 00:36:50, i.e. the pod itself is up while returning errors.

quote is not down: its Deployment sets QUOTE_PORT=8080 and containerPort 8080, the quote Service maps port 8080 to targetPort 8080, and the quote Service endpoints contain the ready address of pod quote-6b5877698d-6spfl on port 8080.

Service-level error increases over 10 minutes ending 00:51:47 were concentrated in the checkout path: frontend 1086.86, frontend-proxy 550.75, checkout 541.34, shipping 541.34, while payment (0 both statuses), cart (0), email (0), accounting (0) and product-catalog (0) show no error spans and currency shows only STATUS_CODE_OK (492.22).

Feature-flag-driven fault injection via flagd is not the cause: ConfigMap flagd-config in otel-demo has every flag (adFailure, cartFailure, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure, kafkaQueueProblems, imageSlowLoad, emailMemoryLeak, adHighCpu, adManualGc, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage) at defaultVariant "off", and the flagd pod was created at 00:01:52, well before the 00:36-00:38 onset.

quote unavailability is not the cause: quote's pod is Running and ready with restartCount 0, its Service endpoint resolves to port 8080, and shipping's failure is an InvalidUri parse error taking ~10 microseconds on the outbound POST rather than a connection-refused or timeout error.

The small flagd EventStream error spans on ad, recommendation and fraud-detection (~1.11 per 5m, intermittently 0) are present throughout the sampled window including points before the 00:38 onset (e.g. from 00:27:02 onward), so they are background activity rather than part of this incident's onset.

In the returned error-series view, checkout and shipping error series only have points from 00:39:02 onward, whereas the frontend error series has explicit zero points from 00:13:02, so the shipping/checkout error counters first appear after the 00:36:42-00:36:49 rollout.

The unchanged-image rollout of Deployment shipping (revision 2) carrying QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000" — a value that is not a valid URI and does not point at the quote Service port 8080 — is what makes shipping's quote POST fail with InvalidUri(InvalidFormat), producing shipping /get-quote 500s, checkout PlaceOrder status 13, and the frontend POST /api/checkout 500s counted by the RequestErrorRate alert.

Restore the shipping Deployment's QUOTE_ADDR to the previous valid value ("http://quote:8080", matching quote's Service port 8080) and roll the Deployment again; then confirm that shipping /get-quote and frontend POST /api/checkout error spans return to zero.

gaps: Change history is not integrated in this Run, so who changed the shipping Deployment's QUOTE_ADDR (and the exact edit time before the 00:36:42 ReplicaSet creation) is unknown.

The previous shipping pod (shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q) was deleted at 00:36:49 and its container logs are unavailable ('previous terminated container ... not found'), so pre-change shipping log text could not be read; the pre-incident baseline rests on the frontend error series being 0 up to 00:37:02.

The alerting rule itself could not be verified: list_prometheus_rules returned no rows for rule_name RequestErrorRate and no alerting rules at all in this Prometheus, so the alert expression and its threshold are unknown.
The specific fault-injection declaration (a tool or actor applying QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000") was not observed directly; only its presence in the Deployment and new ReplicaSet is evidenced.
Shipping's application logs contain only startup lines and repeated 'Requesting quote' lines with no error text, so the error detail comes from the shipping spans, not from the container's stdout.

Whether any other workload changed during the window besides the shipping rollout was only partially checked: otel-demo events showed only shipping pod/ReplicaSet/Deployment entries, and data-recorders namespace events (PVC provisioning, FailedScheduling, Jobs) were not investigated as they belong to a different application namespace.
